description: The You tab's all-time numbers and its glance at the track graph, by the web Profile page's rules (services/server/internal/httpapi/profile_page.go): count and distance are sums, active days the number of days, the streak the longest run of consecutive ones; recent weeks are the last weeks through today, Sunday to Saturday column by column, each day 0 for none, then 1, 2 and 3 for three or more, -1 for a day still to come. days are the histogram's buckets, ascending, never one without a track.

cases.name: a streak across the end of February, and a gap
three or more is the darkest, and the last column is this week
